analogy.rationale: Proton pump inhibitors target gastric H+/K+-ATPase (ATP4A/ATP4B), which is not expressed in these cell lines, so they should produce little to no transcriptional response; the closest listed classes are other ATPase/channel/transporter inhibitors, but they act on different proteins and are only weakly similar.
